kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln. And, Jared Kushner to meet with Netanyahu
wire.summary: The USS Washington is on its way to the Middle East to relieve the USS Lincoln amid concerns about conditions aboard. And, Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Prime Minister Netanyahu to move Gaza talks forward.

wire.title: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
wire.summary: A child actor since she was cast in various commercials as an 11-month-old, Panettiere was best known for her role as the country music star Juliette Barnes in the series "Nashville."

wire.title: As wildfires get worse, some states are struggling to pass fire protection rules
wire.summary: There's a lot homeowners can do to prepare for wildfires, such as managing flammable plants and using fire-resistant building materials. But some states struggle to pass rules requiring those steps.

wire.title: Missed shifts were costly to this McDonald's. An app has fixed the problem
wire.summary: Unexpected absences can cost employers tens of thousands of dollars a month. An app that helps workers with last-minute transportation, food and childcare is making a difference.

wire.title: Cialis is an erectile dysfunction drug. Could it also help you live longer?
wire.summary: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.

wire.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
wire.summary: For 10 years, a Catholic-run home offered young women an affordable place to live in the nation's capital as they studied and launched careers. Now, that community is saying goodbye.

wire.title: Meta heads to court in a landmark trial about kids and social media addiction
wire.summary: Four states are suing the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, alleging that the platforms were designed to hook kids and that Meta hid the mental health risks.

wire.title: Advocates worry new bans on student IDs will trip up young voters
wire.summary: New bans on using student IDs for voting in Indiana and New Hampshire have sparked lawsuits after creating the latest hurdles to the ballot box for the U.S. voting-age group least likely to vote.

wire.title: Elon Musk's Starbase wants to expand in south Texas
wire.summary: Landowners and activists worry about impact to the environment around SpaceX's complex.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln after concerns about conditions, Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks on Russia, a look at where talks stand regarding the future of Gaza.

wire.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
wire.summary: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

wire.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
wire.summary: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

wire.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
wire.summary: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

wire.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
wire.summary: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

wire.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
wire.summary: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

wire.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
wire.summary: The leading opposition candidate calls allegations of a planned insurrection as "total fabrications".
